card.name: Words before law and court names
card.fires_on: Short linking words (of, to, for, with, steps) and name-starting letters in legal or policy prose, just before a named act, court case, justice or standard.

modes.label: Link word before a law
modes.description: A short preposition or connector right before a named bill, act or ruling.
modes.example: the effect<< of>> S.787 is a transfer

modes.label: Start of a split name
modes.description: The first letter of a proper name split into pieces, such as a case, justice or standards body.
modes.example: US Supreme Court ruling (<<R>>apanos v. United States), the

modes.label: Verb or link in court talk
modes.description: A word like with, to or steps in discussion of justices, courts and government action.
modes.example: A majority of justices is likely to disagree<< with>> the administration.

card.plain: It fires on small connecting words in legal and policy writing where a law, court case or official name comes next.
